subject: session, config, sessionctx, executor: Set tidb_opt_projection_push_down to false when tidb upgrades from versions older than 8.3.0 to 8.3.0 and later (#54861)
summary: Promotes `tidb_opt_projection_push_down` to a global+session sysvar with default ON for new installs, and on upgrade-to-ver210 initializes the global value to OFF when upgrading from <8.3.0. Deprecates the `performance.projection-push-down` config knob and adds SET/GET coverage in executor tests.
